title: openwiz:status v1
description: The fields of one status note, as read from its key: value lines after the marker line '<!-- openwiz:status v1 -->'. See agent-status.v1.md for the note's text form, which notes count, the claim rules, the people-set labels and what a note never holds.

skills.description: Every skill the agent ran, each <skill>@<version>, joined by ', '. The shape only: a writer also requires each to be a skill of its installed package at that package's version.

preview.description: A public https page: a domain name host (no localhost, IP address or .local, .internal, .lan or .localhost name), an optional port and path, and no user, password, query or fragment.

label.description: The five labels people set. Agents add or clear needs-info only for their own asking note.

state.description: The four states. A note is live while working or asking and edited within the last 30 minutes.
